title: E-MTR-0030: a sector eigensolver for the register pair from one autocorrelation (filter diagonalization, since the...
purpose: Experiment E-MTR-0030 in the spin arena: a sector eigensolver for the register pair from one autocorrelation (filter diagonalization, since the engine has no inverse cycle for Lanczos): partial, exact five times below the Fourier limit on known lines and within 1.1e-8 of the $a_B$ 8 read, but the $a_B$ 12 ground is pinned only to about 1e-6 by 8,450 cycles, by either method.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
